about: Signatures of the boundaries entail wraps in engine code (LIBRARY_DESIGN.md 4.6; ROADMAP M4.2). One row per producer, named engine.role.name: the step `writes` leaves the value `value` holding these facts, the step `reads` takes it so, and `moves` says where the step puts the values it was given. evidence: measured (healthy runs and planted defects on the engine) or code (read, not run).

rows.ref: apply calls torch.nn.functional.linear, which reads (out, in); the weight is final when the checkpoint has been read. entail/audits/D_LEDGER.md results 3, 4, 4-1: 144 layers of a healthy Qwen3-4B pass; rows rolled by one, transposed weights and strided views are caught

quantization/online/fp8.py quantises while the checkpoint is read and stores qweight.t() - shape (in, out), strides (1, in) - with one scale; its kernel reads it so. entail/audits/D_LEDGER.md results 3, 4-1: 144 layers of a healthy Qwen3-4B pass (a first version that declared it dense produced 144 complaints on a healthy server)

not_values.vllm.quant_method.UnquantizedEmbeddingMe: an embedding table: its sizes are vocabulary and hidden size, not in and out features
not_values.vllm.quant_method.Fp8KVCacheMethod: holds the KV cache scales of an attention layer; there is no weight
